author: kolby85
body: This was my favorite server in the world and after i was banned i started cutting myself i have finally stopped and i will never make such a TERRIBLE MISTAKE EVER. I presume you will not accept this, for i cannot find the layout for ban appeals. I was banned on December 3rd, 2015 By SR.Mod Jiveh For trigger bot, and also after i was banned i turned to csgo but the love for this server has brought me back once again, I ask for one reason. The reason is that that this is my very last chance and i almost never get chances. All i want to do is go back to playing Nebula, also i was Gold rank i will probably rankup if i am unbanned.
